text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Seiun Sky didn't show up for training, so as I wandered around campus looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was sleeping on the rooftop, wearing clothes completely out of place for the setting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is definitely the "Droit" outfit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate it, though! It's actually
surprisingly stretchy and breathable, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So it's the same as tracksuits. Which means pajamas are fine too.
That's that.
choice_data_list: Wait, why are you taking a nap because of that...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's a total tragedy.
Not only did I slack off on my laundry,
but all the dorm's washing machines broke down too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: On top of that, I got caught up in El and Grass-chan's game of tag, and my uniform got soaking wet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just didn't have anything else to wear.
An-And so, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We're in a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting vigorously down the stairs...
she was now pressed up against the window of an empty classroom on the second floor.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, shh.
...It's that girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze,
I saw a kitten clinging desperately to the end
of a high branch that nearly reached the second floor.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It feels within reach, yet I can't quite grasp it.
Just a little bit more, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We take turns leaning out, but we're still
a little out of reach. While we're struggling—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blown by a sudden gust of wind, the kitten tilted precariously.
It clung desperately to the branch, looking ready to fall at any secondâ

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: I'll support you, so reach out your hand!
Let's hurry down to the first floor!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay...!
Here I go, please hold this steady for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky leans over and stretches out her hand.
Just a little more and she'll reach it. Just as that thought crosses her mind,
the kitten slips—and falls!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that exact moment, Seiun Sky kicked off the windowsill and jumped down without a moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And catching the kitten mid-fall,
she rolled to absorb the impact and landed flawlessly."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There, there.
Come here, kitty, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oops, there she goes.
That caught you off guard, didn't it? Nyahaha.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Trainer, really...
What's with that look on your face?
choice_data_list: I had no idea you could move so nimbly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no~, when push comes to shove, anyone
can do it. Plus, the clothes were easy to move in~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Still, well, let's keep this between us just in case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky put an index finger to her lips, looking just a little embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In a hurry... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No sooner had she said that than Seiun Sky placed her foot on the classroom window frame. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hup, hop, ...there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaping down gracefully, she hopped from window frames to rain gutters
like an acrobat, and reached the ground
in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, up we go.
Here, kitty kitty~
choice_data_list: You could do something like that!?
You could do something like that!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah...
I mean, stairs are such a pain, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And so, by taking shortcuts every now and then, I eventually figured out how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, look, it's a kitty cat.
Here, kitty kitty, don't be afraid, come jump over here~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few seconds later, the kitten fell, but thanks to
Seiun Sky being on standby and catching it,
it was completely unharmed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good.
You can't go climbing up too high, okay? Promise Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, you understand?
Aren't you adorable? Meow, meow, meow."
